title: Genome-Wide Chromatin Structure Changes During Caste Differentiation in Honeybees.
authors: Zhang, Xinru; Lu, Hanbing; Qu, Xinying; Xin, Lingjun; Wang, Rongshen; Liang, Chongbo; Liu, Xiaopeng; Chen, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜜蜂级型分化中的全基因组染色质结构变化，涉及基因表达和甲基化调控，但未涉及cpcdh基因家族，仅可作为表观遗传调控机制的借鉴。
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) chromatin architecture is an important transcription regulator which is linked to gene expression regulation and correct developmental programs, yet little is known that the 3D chromatin architecture within honeybees and how it influences gene expression and methylation in caste differentiation. Here, we report that larvae at 96 h after hatching (L5) contain the highest number of known caste differentiation genes, and that constitutes the critical window determining the final phenotypic outcomes. We also show that DNA methylation pattern is conserved and gene body methylation is thought to contribute to phenotypic plasticity. Then, we determine the 3D organization of honey bee chromosomes at 5 kb resolution. Although almost 87% regions remained in the same compartments, TAD boundary insulation increased during larvae development, especially in worker larvae at 96 h after hatching (WL5). The insulator protein, CP190, CTCF-L and vtd/Rad21 appear to be indispensable in defining these topologically associating domain boundaries. Furthermore, Mrjp1, a member of the MRJP/yellow family, is also involved in regulating larval development. These results provide key insights into caste differentiation and establish a fundamental dataset for the future in-depth characterization of epigenetic features.
abstract_zh: 三维（3D）染色质结构是重要的转录调控因子，与基因表达调控和正确的发育程序相关，然而关于蜜蜂体内的3D染色质结构及其如何影响 caste differentiation 中的基因表达和甲基化，目前知之甚少。在此，我们报道，孵化后96小时（L5）的幼虫含有最多已知的 caste differentiation 基因，这构成了决定最终表型结果的关键窗口。我们还表明，DNA甲基化模式是保守的，且基因体甲基化被认为有助于表型可塑性。随后，我们以5 kb分辨率确定了蜜蜂染色体的3D组织。尽管几乎87%的区域保持在相同的 compartments 中，但TAD边界绝缘在幼虫发育过程中增加，尤其是在孵化后96小时的工蜂幼虫（WL5）中。绝缘体蛋白CP190、CTCF-L和vtd/Rad21似乎在定义这些拓扑关联结构域边界中不可或缺。此外，Mrjp1，MRJP/yellow家族的一员，也参与调控幼虫发育。这些结果为 caste differentiation 提供了关键见解，并为未来深入表征表观遗传特征建立了基础数据集。
